A total of 253 KP were isolated in this study: 39% (n=99/253) originated from pigs, 34% (n=87/253) from contacts, and 26.4% (n=67/253) from non-contacts (Table S1 and Figure S1).
These were collected from the same food type (chicken meat or salads) at different times in the same country (Table S6, Fig. S5).

Of the 299 carbapenemase-positive isolates where the specimen type was documented, there were 126 (42.1%) from urine samples, 104 (34.8%) from screening rectal swabs or fecal samples, 25 (8.4%) from blood cultures.
